steps.summary: Each screen's look and wording is written down, and the build order is planned.
Owners name their studio after signing up; clients and numbered invoices with worked-out totals, statuses and the amount still owed now work.
The Team screen adds colleagues with a starting password; they sign in and share the studio's clients and invoices.
Ready to share: a loading message, a try-again screen when a page fails, and the app is hidden from search engines.
Browser checks now cover sign-up, adding a colleague, clients, invoices from draft to paid, and studio separation; they found and fixed a sideways scroll on the Clients page on phones.

Walked every screen in the browser: fixed misaligned invoice line boxes when errors show, an underlined New invoice button, a mismatched column heading, and owners appearing nameless (the studio screen now asks for your name).
Every screen and route checks who is asking and keeps each studio to its own data; fixed invoices with huge amounts failing on save, which are now refused with a clear message.
